HACK PARADISE 2026

Innovate. Build. Transform

Hackathon | Programmers’ Paradise Technical Society (PPTS)
CSVTU – University Teaching Department, Bhilai

About Hack Paradise

Hack Paradise is a technology-driven hackathon that brings together innovators, developers, and problem-solvers to develop creative and impactful solutions to real-world challenges.

The hackathon aims to encourage innovation, technical excellence, collaboration, and practical implementation through a combination of online idea evaluation and an offline hackathon.

Participants will compete across four thematic tracks and one Open Innovation Challenge, with opportunities for both Software and Software + Hardware solutions.

 Hackathon Categories

 1. Software

Solutions involving web applications, mobile applications, AI/ML models, software systems, APIs, automation, and other software-based technologies.

2. Software + Hardware

Solutions integrating software with hardware components such as IoT devices, sensors, embedded systems, robotics, and other physical technologies.

Themes & Problem Domains

Theme 1: Gov-Independent CivicTech

Develop innovative solutions addressing community challenges, public infrastructure, local service coordination, and civic well-being.

Suggested areas:

- Community issue reporting and resolution
- Public facility management
- Neighborhood safety platforms
- Local service coordination
- Smart community infrastructure

Theme 2: HealthTech

Explore healthcare and medical technology solutions that improve healthcare accessibility, patient experience, health monitoring, and medical service delivery.

Suggested areas:

- Digital healthcare platforms
- Health monitoring and wellness
- Medical data management
- Healthcare accessibility
- AI-powered healthcare assistance

Theme 3: EdTech

Develop innovative solutions that enhance education, learning experiences, accessibility, and skill development through technology.

Suggested areas:

- Digital learning platforms
- Personalized learning and AI tutors
- Educational accessibility
- Skill development and assessment
- Student and institutional management

Theme 4: Cybersecurity & Digital Trust

Create solutions that enhance digital security, protect privacy, and establish trust in digital systems.

Suggested areas:

- Fraud detection and prevention
- Data privacy and protection
- Digital identity security
- Deepfake detection
- Secure authentication and digital trust

 Open Innovation Challenge

Hack Anything. Solve Something.

Participants are free to identify and solve any real-world problem of their choice, irrespective of the predefined themes.

This track encourages interdisciplinary innovation, unconventional ideas, and creative applications of technology across any domain.

Hackathon Structure

Hack Paradise will be conducted in two stages.

Round 1: Online Evaluation

PPT Submission Deadline: 17 November 2026

Teams must submit a PowerPoint presentation outlining their proposed idea and solution through the designated submission platform.

The presentations will be evaluated by the judging panel based on innovation, relevance, feasibility, and technical approach.

Online Evaluation Results: 20 November 2026

Shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the offline hackathon.

Round 2: Offline Hackathon & Final Evaluation

Selected teams will be invited to CSVTU UTD Bhilai for the main Hack Paradise event.

During the offline hackathon, teams are expected to complete the major portion of their proposed solutions and demonstrate substantial implementation progress.

Participants may fine-tune their solutions, improve functionality, and prepare their projects for the final evaluation.

The offline round will conclude with the final evaluation and demonstration of the developed solutions before the judging panel.

PPT Submission Guidelines

Presentation Length: 5 - 7 Slides

Teams must submit a PowerPoint presentation of 5 - 7 slides for the online evaluation.

The suggested structure is as follows:

Slide Content
Slide 1 Title & Team Introduction: Project title, selected theme, category (Software / Software + Hardware), team name, and member details.
Slide 2 Problem Statement: Clearly define the problem, its background, significance, and the target beneficiaries.
Slide 3 Proposed Solution: Explain the solution, its core idea, and how it addresses the identified problem.
Slide 4 Innovation & Uniqueness: Highlight the innovative aspects, distinguishing features, and advantages over existing solutions.
Slide 5 Technology Stack & Implementation: Mention technologies, tools, frameworks, hardware components (if applicable), and the proposed implementation approach.
Slide 6 Feasibility, Impact & Future Scope: Explain feasibility, expected impact, scalability, and potential future improvements.
Slide 7 Prototype / Architecture / Conclusion: Include a prototype design, workflow, architecture diagram, mock-up, or concluding summary.

Note: The above structure is a suggested guideline. Teams may customize the presentation according to their project requirements while ensuring that all essential aspects of their proposed solution are covered.

PPT Submission Requirements

  • Presentations must contain 5 - 7 slides.
  • PPTs must be submitted by 17 November 2026. (PPT must be named after Team's Name Eg: HackParadise.pptx)
  • The problem statement and proposed solution must be clearly explained.
  • Teams must specify their selected theme and hackathon category.
  • The presentation should be concise, structured, and visually clear.
  • Relevant diagrams, flowcharts, mock-ups, or illustrations are encouraged.
  • Teams must ensure originality and acknowledge external resources, datasets, and third-party contributions.
  • The PPT should demonstrate the feasibility of completing a substantial portion of the solution during the offline hackathon.

Evaluation Criteria

Online Evaluation

Criteria Description
Problem Relevance Importance and clarity of the problem
Innovation Originality and uniqueness of the proposed idea
Technical Feasibility Practicality of the implementation approach
Solution Approach Effectiveness and clarity of the proposed solution
Potential Impact Expected benefits and scalability
Presentation Quality Clarity, organization, and communication

Offline Evaluation

Criteria Description
Innovation & Originality Uniqueness and creativity of the solution
Technical Implementation Quality and completeness of implementation
Functionality Working prototype and demonstration
Problem-Solving Effectiveness How effectively the solution addresses the problem
Feasibility & Scalability Practical applicability and future potential
Presentation & Demonstration Clarity of explanation and project demonstration

Important Dates

Event Date
Online PPT Submission Deadline 17 November 2026
Online Evaluation Results 20 November 2026
Offline Hackathon 28 November 2026

Why Participate in Hack Paradise?

  • Showcase your innovative ideas and technical skills.
  • Solve real-world challenges through technology.
  • Develop practical solutions and functional prototypes.
  • Collaborate with fellow innovators.
  • Gain exposure through expert evaluation and project demonstrations.
  • Compete for exciting prizes, recognition, and opportunities.

    Join our whatsapp channel after registering here for further details : 8 Hour Hackathon

Hack Paradise 2026 - Where Ideas Become Innovation.
